question: In the Aspen Plus models of biodiesel production by triolein transesterification, what triolein conversion and FAME yield does Model 1 achieve at the optimum conditions?
expect: 96.4% conversion; 7.46 kg/h FAME (~7.5 kg/h) (abstract; conclusion p11)
